title: Growth Roadmap
pitch: The decision as a schedule: a sticky time ruler with named eras and a scrubber that runs a growth model through Gantt-style swimlanes of milestones, charts and pinnable cards.
bestFor: Answers that depend on when: growth thresholds, dated evidence, price or vendor changes, phased plans with re-evaluation gates.
weakness: Needs a time axis to earn its place; static comparisons sit in plain reference blocks below it, and projected dates are only as good as the growth assumption behind them.
signals: a break-even or threshold reached as something grows
a phased plan or re-evaluation gate
a model whose outputs change month by month
avoid: a single static comparison or ranking
an argument meant to be read top to bottom
many unrelated parts whose structure matters more than their order
